_doc: The database-backed suite's wall-clock budget, and the band it actually runs in.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. On 17 Aug 2026 the api suite's testTimeout was raised
from vitest's 5s default to 20s. The default describes LOCAL latency and
these tests make real TLS round trips to a remote Postgres, so 5s was
refusing at random rather than refusing to proceed, and a random red teaches
re-running, which is the habit that eventually swallows a real one.
Raising a timeout hides a genuine performance regression. THIS FILE IS WHAT
KEEPS THAT DISTINCTION CHECKABLE: the per-test budget got looser, and a
budget on the whole run replaced what it gave up.
The band is written down rather than computed from the run, because a check
that reads its expectation from the thing it is checking cannot disagree
with it. When a failure fires, the message quotes this band so the reader
can tell a regression from the top of the spread.
UPDATING IT: if the band genuinely moves, change observedBand and say why in
the commit. Raising maxMs to make a red go away is the thing this file

observedBand.cause: variance in Neon branch provisioning, not in any one test
